hud.title: Satchel
quest.title: Quest
quest.body: Talk to mages (🧙 + A button), go through doors 🚪 and learn variables, conditions and loops.
tutorial.title: Welcome, Code Mage!
tutorial.body: Move with arrows/WASD or the touch pad. Stand on a 🧙 or a 🚪 and press A (or Enter). Creatures in the grass ✦ ask Python questions.
npc.title: Mentor mage
npc.village: Welcome to Pyra! A variable is a box: x = 5. In Java/C++ you write int x = 5; — in Python, no type and no semicolon.
npc.forest: In the forest: reassign x = 6, or x += 1 to increment (like x++ in C++). Types include int, float and str.
npc.crypt: In the crypt, choose with if / elif / else. Example: if hp > 0: print('alive'). Colon + indentation, no braces.
npc.tower: The tower repeats: for i in range(3): gives 0, 1, 2.
battle.title: Knowledge duel
dex.body: Pythodex: 🦊 Pyfou and 👹 Bugzilla. Defeat them to add them.
